# Issam Baloushi, The Languages Ninja

> Private, tailor-made tours of Oman with Issam Baloushi, a Muscat guide who speaks 12 languages plus Arabic. Muscat, Nizwa, Wahiba desert and Wadi Shab. Book on WhatsApp.

Issam Baloushi ("The Languages Ninja") is a private tour guide based in Muscat, Oman. Tours are guided in Arabic plus 12 languages: English, Spanish, Italian, German, French, Chinese, Portuguese, Catalan, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Hindi. Tours are private, with hotel pickup in Muscat. Bookings are made on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/96800000000) or with the tour request form. Interpreting and translation are also available.

## Tours

- [Muscat City Private Tour](https://juanius-ahos.github.io/issam-oman-tours/en/tours/muscat-city/): A private Muscat city tour in your language: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Mutrah Souq and Corniche, the Royal Opera House and Old Muscat. Hotel pickup included.
- [Nizwa and Jebel Akhdar Private Tour](https://juanius-ahos.github.io/issam-oman-tours/en/tours/nizwa-mountains/): A private day trip from Muscat to Nizwa Fort and Souq, the abandoned village of Birkat Al Mouz and the terraces of Jebel Akhdar, guided in your language.
- [Wahiba Sands Desert Private Tour](https://juanius-ahos.github.io/issam-oman-tours/en/tours/wahiba-desert/): A private overnight trip to the Wahiba Sands (Sharqiya Sands) with a swim in Wadi Bani Khalid, dune driving, sunset and a desert camp, guided in your language.
- [Wadi Shab and Bimmah Sinkhole Private Tour](https://juanius-ahos.github.io/issam-oman-tours/en/tours/wadi-shab-coast/): A private coastal day trip from Muscat to the Bimmah Sinkhole, Fins beach and Wadi Shab with its hike, pools and cave waterfall, guided in your language.

## FAQ

- How much does a private tour cost? Placeholder answer. Prices depend on the tour, the group size and the season. Send your dates and group size on WhatsApp and you get a clear price for the whole group, with no per-head surprises.
- Where do you pick us up? Placeholder answer. From any hotel, apartment or cruise terminal in Muscat. Pickup from other cities can be arranged.
- How long are the tours? Placeholder answer. Muscat city is a half or full day, Nizwa and Wadi Shab are full days, and the Wahiba desert is an overnight trip. Every tour can be shortened or extended.
- Which languages do you guide in? Placeholder answer. Arabic plus English, Spanish, Italian, German, French, Chinese, Portuguese, Catalan, Russian, Korean, Japanese and Hindi. Mixed-language groups are welcome.
- How big can the group be? Placeholder answer. Tours are private, from one traveler up to six in one vehicle. Larger groups can travel with a second vehicle.
- How do we book and pay? Placeholder answer. Message on WhatsApp or send the request form. A small deposit secures the date and the rest is paid on the day.
